def transform(grid):
    divider = next(r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if row and all(v == 5 for v in row))
    colors = sorted({v for row in grid for v in row if v not in (0, 5)})
    upper = [sum(row.count(c) for row in grid[:divider]) for c in colors]
    lower = [sum(row.count(c) for row in grid[divider + 1:]) for c in colors]
    color = colors[max(range(len(colors)), key=lambda i: abs(upper[i] - lower[i]))]
    return [[color, color], [color, color]]
